values./description: Strange objects and static encounters found in the Wasteland.
values./results/@0cce987a5f55adba/description: A suspicious scavenger struggles with a refrigerator. Opening its difficulty 3 lock reveals one random ranged weapon, 1d20 appropriate ammunition, and 3d20 caps.
values./results/@30d3f02e8f2cc4a9/description: A claimed bomb shelter hatch needs one mini-nuke or three wired grenades/mines (difficulty 2 INT + Explosives), placed with difficulty 3 PER + Explosives. Inside: a skeleton, 3 junk items, and 2 random food items.
values./results/@69a4b9715c5dfe7a/description: A crater contains a safe with a GM-set PER + Lockpick difficulty. It holds Xd20 caps, where X is that difficulty.
values./results/@ecd7c269afacb775/description: A wastelander sells alcoholic drinks and local news. They carry 3d20 caps but do not buy.
values./results/@60b2eb6668d6c656/description: There are 3+3 CD fragmentation mines. Effects indicate something untouched at the centre. Disarming each mine is difficulty 2 PER + Explosives; failure detonates it.
values./results/@be368ae9fd00678e/description: Two Brotherhood knights and storage yield one random weapon, one random armor piece, and one random chem; encounter level is PCs’ level +2 for these rolls.
values./results/@199fcbb180567075/description: There are 3+3 CD barrels, each holding 1 radioactive material. Recovery takes one minute per barrel and proximity inflicts 2 CD radiation damage per minute. Effects add a Mighty animal with Feral and Glowing.
values./results/@bfaa9a4b3215b570/description: There are 3d20 tires (minimum 10), each yielding 3 Rubber. Taking one requires difficulty 2 AGI + Athletics; failure inflicts 3 CD Persistent energy damage and retrieves nothing.
values./results/@ad49963a7db50a62/description: Ten minutes yield 1+1 CD Steel. Roll 1 CD: 1-2, a scavenger strips it; Effect, abandoned with feral ghouls equal to PCs +1; otherwise abandoned.
